'''Islands Outpost''' was an outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established at the [[Incorporation Islands]] of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]]. During the [[Kaggath (Galactic War)|Kaggath]] [[Darth Thanaton]] removed the commander of the [[115th]] stationed at the Outpost and replaced him with his loyalist [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skar (Sith)|Skar]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Islands Outpost appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
